title: Letter and Alibi
author: Felix Montrose
blurb: Isandro Underhill, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
